_.adamfoster._: Benedikt "Hollow" Adamfoster came up on Day 12 carrying news from Saint-Lune. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

Benedikt "Hollow" Adamfoster checked the safety catch three times before handing over the post. The man taking over noticed, and checked it once more. A letter from home reached Benedikt "Hollow" Adamfoster before dusk. Benedikt "Hollow" Adamfoster read it twice and slept a little easier.

Benedikt "Hollow" Adamfoster found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful. A letter from home reached Benedikt "Hollow" Adamfoster before dusk. Benedikt "Hollow" Adamfoster read it twice and slept a little easier.

A supply man offered Benedikt "Hollow" Adamfoster a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records. A letter from home reached Benedikt "Hollow" Adamfoster before dusk. Benedikt "Hollow" Adamfoster read it twice and slept a little easier.

At V-F4 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Benedikt "Hollow" Adamfoster turned around and took a shovel blow. Jonas Quazzii of the Hegemony was already gone. Raider: Jonas Quazzii of the Hegemony (@quazzii_7). The letter for Benedikt "Hollow" Adamfoster was written in pencil, with a lot of crossing out. Benedikt "Hollow" Adamfoster liked the crossed-out parts best.
Benedikt "Hollow" Adamfoster spent the day with his arm in a sling, writing letters for men who cannot write.
_timharding: On Day 17, Hugo Timharding arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
akind47: The old hands of S-R6 have been here since Day 1. Dorian "Rabbit" Akind has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Dorian "Rabbit" Akind shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Leopold Mejci, was grazed. Dorian "Rabbit" Akind walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir. Orders came through: Dorian "Rabbit" Akind is a sapper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only his mother's thimble.

Dorian "Rabbit" Akind (Hegemony) and Roland "Mole" Tuckerdesave (Concord) watched each other through the same loophole at the Drowned Farm for an hour. Neither fired. Neither will explain why. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dorian "Rabbit" Akind. Dorian "Rabbit" Akind read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Dorian "Rabbit" Akind folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Henrik "Brick" Dingle and Dorian "Rabbit" Akind sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dorian "Rabbit" Akind. Dorian "Rabbit" Akind read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Dorian "Rabbit" Akind spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dorian "Rabbit" Akind. Dorian "Rabbit" Akind read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Dorian "Rabbit" Akind went out with the wiring party at S-R6. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dorian "Rabbit" Akind. Dorian "Rabbit" Akind read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Dorian "Rabbit" Akind reads Henrik "Brick" Dingle's letters from home out loud, because Brick never learned to read. Rabbit leaves out the sad parts. Brick knows. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dorian "Rabbit" Akind. Dorian "Rabbit" Akind read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Dorian "Rabbit" Akind went out with a patrol to Grey Mill and did not come back with it. He is listed as missing. The men leave his rations untouched.

Dorian "Rabbit" Akind returned by a trench nobody thought passable. He asked for water before explaining how little of it was still a trench. The corporal called out the mail. Dorian "Rabbit" Akind heard the name and almost ran.
chloe.g.t: Albin Chloe arrived with the evening ration party, carrying his brother's pocket watch and a borrowed greatcoat two sizes too big.
At the Weeping Orchard, Albin Chloe of the Hegemony and Edmund "Whistle" Es of the Concord fired at the same loose sheet of metal. The wind kept winning.
Jakub Virajvirxgil and Albin Chloe shared the last tin of bully beef in the bay, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.

The party came back from Calvary Farm by different routes. By dawn, everyone had been accounted for except Albin Chloe. The report confirmed that the Concord held Verdel Ridge. Albin Chloe read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
The sentry nearly shot Albin Chloe coming in through the wire. He had been lost near Lantern Hill for two days, living on puddle water and stubbornness.
Albin Chloe measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.

Albin Chloe caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again. The Hegemony flag went up over Hill 304. Albin Chloe did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Albin Chloe raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F8. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Wendel "Mole" Day of the Concord (@selfie_and_mugs_every_day2.0).

Albin Chloe no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. A letter from home found Albin Chloe before the night shift. Albin Chloe folded it small and kept it close.
Albin Chloe lent Gideon Jimmysparrow a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'.
Albin Chloe traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Albin Chloe was hit hard in the fight at S-F8 before anyone could fire. The raider was Florian Maann of the Concord. Raider: Florian Maann of the Concord (@manmc.maann). Blackwater Canal has been won. Albin Chloe listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch. A letter from home found Albin Chloe before the night shift. Albin Chloe folded it small and kept it close.

Albin Chloe was carrying water up to S-F8 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Albin Chloe did not. Shot by Gideon Wolves of the Concord (@living_with_wild_wolves). A letter from home found Albin Chloe before the night shift. Albin Chloe folded it small and kept it close. The clerk counted the names twice. Albin Chloe is number 105 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Albin Chloe during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Albin Chloe did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.
Another member of the House of Chloe reached the line: Ulrich Chloe. He asked where Albin Chloe had slept, then chose a different corner.
Ulrich Chloe was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony.

A bullet struck Ulrich Chloe below the ribs at S-F8. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Florian "Doc" Raumeidechse of the Concord (@raumeidechse). Ulrich Chloe was killed on watch at S-F8. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Florian "Doc" Raumeidechse of the Concord (@raumeidechse).
Pavel Chloe joined S-F8 under the shadow of Ulrich Chloe's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
A single shot from across the wire hit Pavel Chloe in the thigh at S-F8. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Florian Hsrr of the Concord (@jere.hsrr).
Nobody could reach Pavel Chloe in time. He died on a stretcher by the aid post wall, one of too many waiting.
The House of Chloe sent another. Wendel Chloe, brother of Pavel Chloe, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
Wendel Chloe was hit in the forearm at S-F8. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Nils Photo of the Concord (@yoi.photo).
dian_2011_08: At the depot, Clement "Rabbit" Dian had practised answering to his name. At R-S4, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Clement "Rabbit" Dian. The men named it the Parson and said it had chosen him.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Clement "Rabbit" Dian kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Matthias "Bones" Dawg and Clement "Rabbit" Dian spent an hour hunting rats with a bucket and a piece of cheese. Score at dusk: rats 4, soldiers 1. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Clement "Rabbit" Dian answered to number 534. Grey Mill is lost. Clement "Rabbit" Dian heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
the Parson the crow follows Clement "Rabbit" Dian along the trench now. When the Parson flies off, men duck. They are usually right to.
A patient apologized for bleeding on Clement "Rabbit" Dian's sleeve. He told the patient to concentrate on staying awake.
Clement "Rabbit" Dian sorted the dressings by lamplight. When the next stretcher arrived, he could find everything without looking.
A round went through the rim of Clement "Rabbit" Dian's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Wendel Jesus of the Hegemony (@jesus.gr9).
Clement "Rabbit" Dian's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
Somebody in R-S4 wanted to shoot the Parson for the pot. Clement "Rabbit" Dian stood in front of the rifle. The matter has been dropped.
fully_automatic_dark_jokes: Gideon "Hollow" Jokes, a schoolteacher from Rosenau, was sent forward on Day 11 to fill a gap in P-F15. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it. Victory at Grey Mill. Gideon "Hollow" Jokes let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Gideon "Hollow" Jokes closed his eyes while someone else distributed them. A letter from home found Gideon "Hollow" Jokes before the night shift. Gideon "Hollow" Jokes folded it small and kept it close.
Florian Dcf held the mirror while Gideon "Hollow" Jokes shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Gideon "Hollow" Jokes took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at P-F15, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. A letter from home found Gideon "Hollow" Jokes before the night shift. Gideon "Hollow" Jokes folded it small and kept it close.

Gideon "Hollow" Jokes lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant. A letter from home found Gideon "Hollow" Jokes before the night shift. Gideon "Hollow" Jokes folded it small and kept it close.

Gideon "Hollow" Jokes never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line. A letter for Gideon "Hollow" Jokes came with a photograph. Gideon "Hollow" Jokes looked at it for a long time and said nothing.

A familiar voice came out of the fog in the wrong direction. Gideon "Hollow" Jokes waited for the password before answering. The letter for Gideon "Hollow" Jokes ended with 'come home soon'. Gideon "Hollow" Jokes read the last line more than the rest.
ghostbebrii: Emil Ghostbebrii joined the replacements on Day 3. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.

Emil Ghostbebrii fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Norbert Seamus, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. A bullet clipped Emil Ghostbebrii's helmet at S-F18 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Albin Warhamster of the Concord (@warhamster4).

Emil Ghostbebrii wore a fresh bandage at S-F18 and was told to rest. He rested for about an hour. Mail came up the line with a letter for Emil Ghostbebrii. Emil Ghostbebrii read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Emil Ghostbebrii's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. Orders came through: Emil Ghostbebrii is a signaller now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a key to a house that is no longer there. News that the Hegemony had taken Hill 304 reached Emil Ghostbebrii during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Emil Ghostbebrii as a story about a general. The ending was the same. Mail came up the line with a letter for Emil Ghostbebrii. Emil Ghostbebrii read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A bullet found Emil Ghostbebrii at S-F18, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Felix "Spark" Toastybweady of the Concord (@toastybweady). Mail came up the line with a letter for Emil Ghostbebrii. Emil Ghostbebrii read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

For days Emil Ghostbebrii was too weak to sit up on the stretcher. This morning he sat up, then stood, then asked for his rifle. Mail came up the line with a letter for Emil Ghostbebrii. Emil Ghostbebrii read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Emil Ghostbebrii was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-F18. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Norbert Seamus of the Concord (@seamus_bj).

The wound on Emil Ghostbebrii's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Emil Ghostbebrii watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

A bullet hit Emil Ghostbebrii in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at S-F18. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Rafael Warhamster of the Concord (@warhamster4). The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Emil Ghostbebrii answered to number 234. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Emil Ghostbebrii did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

An orderly waved the bearers in: one bed, cleared and scrubbed. Emil Ghostbebrii was lifted onto it in the hospital dugout. Mail came up the line with a letter for Emil Ghostbebrii. Emil Ghostbebrii read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A surgeon stopped at Emil Ghostbebrii's bed, checked the dressing and moved on without a word. He decided that was good news. Mail came up the line with a letter for Emil Ghostbebrii. Emil Ghostbebrii read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The stretcher Emil Ghostbebrii lay on for so long has a dent the shape of a body. Emil Ghostbebrii is back at S-F18, and someone else is lying in that dent now. Mail came up the line with a letter for Emil Ghostbebrii. Emil Ghostbebrii read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Emil Ghostbebrii carried Gideon "Bones" Carnahanwile's rifle all the way up to the Bone Quarry after Bones twisted an ankle. Neither has said thank you. Neither needs to. Mail came up the line with a letter for Emil Ghostbebrii. Emil Ghostbebrii read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Emil Ghostbebrii was on the dawn watch at S-F18 when the Concord raiders came. A club, a shout, and Emil Ghostbebrii was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Nils Guy of the Concord (@hi.its.guy). A letter for Emil Ghostbebrii came all the way from home in nine days. Emil Ghostbebrii counted them on the envelope.

Someone moved Emil Ghostbebrii's stretcher out of the doorway. It was the most anyone did for him all day, and he was grateful. There was a letter for Emil Ghostbebrii and a little tobacco folded inside. The tobacco went round the squad. The letter did not.
horatiu_mateescu: Oskar Mateescu arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying a dented harmonica and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at T-F10 and grazed Oskar Mateescu's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Jakub "Ash" Baron of the Concord (@butter_baron468). The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Oskar Mateescu helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Oskar Mateescu rejoined the squad at T-F10. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there. Victory at Grey Mill. Oskar Mateescu let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Oskar Mateescu and Dietrich Soccer found a cat in the ruins at the Sunken Road and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Dietrich.
Oskar Mateescu owes Bram "Mole" Kong so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full.
Oskar Mateescu washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation.
Oskar Mateescu polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too.

A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at T-F10. Oskar Mateescu was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Viktor Eleisson of the Concord (@kyrie_eleisson).
Another member of the House of Mateescu reached the line: Florian "Whistle" Mateescu. He asked where Oskar Mateescu had slept, then chose a different corner.
Florian "Whistle" Mateescu found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
maks.slc: Norbert Slc told the sergeant he was a fisherman. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed more rain, and put him on sentry.
As one of the first hundred volunteers, Norbert Slc received the First Wave ribbon. A neighbour lent the needle and supervised every stitch.
Victory at Verdel Ridge. Norbert Slc let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
The shelling stopped while Norbert Slc was counting the seconds between hits. He kept counting anyway, and waited a long time before moving.
Norbert Slc lent Casimir "Button" Batman a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'.

Rumour reached S-F9 that the war would be over by spring. Norbert Slc has heard it before. So has everyone. News of the loss of Hill 304 reached S-F9 with the rations. Norbert Slc ate while listening to the revised orders.
Norbert Slc cut Zeno "Shadow" Maximus's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F9 and grazed Norbert Slc's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Arno Toastyy of the Hegemony (@totally.am.toastyy). Norbert Slc had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Ulrich Tom crossed it, Norbert Slc fired. Ulrich Tom was gravely wounded.
Three days with a bandage, and Norbert Slc is back at S-F9. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.

Norbert Slc had just lit a cigarette at S-F9 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Marek "Lucky" Mateorekon of the Hegemony (@mateorekon).

Norbert Slc's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. Blackwater Canal is lost. Norbert Slc heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Norbert Slc's ear at S-F9 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Wendel Gers of the Hegemony (@j0seph_r0gers). Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Norbert Slc stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Norbert Slc rejoined the squad at S-F9. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
A muddy dog crawled into S-F9 through the wire. Norbert Slc gave it half his bread. It has not left his side since. The men call it Kaiser.
The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Norbert Slc spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open.

Norbert Slc borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Dorian "Rabbit" Noahmcelhera was grazed. Norbert Slc has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Matthias "Doc" Gaita, badly wounded. On dawn watch at S-F9, Norbert Slc fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Jakub Aklouisza, now gravely wounded.

At S-F9 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Norbert Slc turned around and took a shovel blow. Quentin Vicious of the Hegemony was already gone. Raider: Quentin Vicious of the Hegemony (@darth._.vicious).
Norbert Slc is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
matthew.ware10718: Zeno Ware arrived at R-F23 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Zeno Ware tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at R-F23 is up. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Hill 304. Zeno Ware read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Zeno Ware spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.
A muddy dog crawled into R-F23 through the wire. Zeno Ware gave it half his bread. It has not left his side since. The men call it Lump.
Lump has learned to carry messages in a tin on its collar. Zeno Ware is very proud. Lump is mainly proud of the biscuits.
Zeno Ware opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first.
Blackwater Canal is lost. Zeno Ware heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Zeno Ware stood at the parapet at dawn with the rest of R-F23, bayonet fixed, staring into the grey. Nothing came. Nothing came yesterday, either. The clerk counted the names twice. Zeno Ware is number 357 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Zeno Ware looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Zeno Ware lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing.
The gas alarm sounded during supper. Zeno Ware put the bread down carefully and did not finish it until the all-clear.
Zeno Ware went out with the wiring party at R-F23. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit.
Zeno Ware had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any.
On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Zeno Ware was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire.
Someone moved Zeno Ware's stretcher out of the doorway. It was the most anyone did for him all day, and he was grateful.
metal_af_420: The sergeant gave Tobias Metal a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 10 or any other.

An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Tobias Metal added a leak above the man's head in pencil. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Tobias Metal read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Tobias Metal's ear at U-F8 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Hugo Suzumi of the Hegemony (@me._.suzumi). The gun at U-F8 jammed twice and fired once. Once was enough: Lucien S, badly wounded.

Tobias Metal was hit in the foot through his boot at U-F8. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Hugo Suzumi of the Hegemony (@me._.suzumi). Tobias Metal stood up to fix a loose sandbag at U-F8. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Hugo Suzumi of the Hegemony (@me._.suzumi).
Quentin Metal arrived carrying the family name of Tobias Metal. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.

Quentin Metal was hit through the chest at U-F8. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Albin Shvedov of the Hegemony (@shvedov10). Quentin Metal was hit at U-F8 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Albin Shvedov of the Hegemony (@shvedov10).
The papers say Arno "Saint" Metal. The sergeant says he has his older brother's eyes. Quentin Metal's eyes. Nobody in U-F8 argues.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Arno "Saint" Metal in the open at U-F8. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Isidor "Ghost" Salerno of the Hegemony (@anthony_salerno17). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Arno "Saint" Metal fell at U-F8 and never moved again. Shot by Isidor "Ghost" Salerno of the Hegemony (@anthony_salerno17).
Karel "Crow" Metal came to the front because his cousin Arno "Saint" Metal never came home. He carries a lucky button.

Karel "Crow" Metal was hit through the stomach at U-F8. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Isidor "Ghost" Salerno of the Hegemony (@anthony_salerno17). Two men fed the belt while Karel "Crow" Metal held the gun steady on the enemy parapet. When they stopped, Anselm Chrisgghill was grazed. Karel "Crow" Metal was killed at U-F8 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Isidor "Ghost" Salerno of the Hegemony (@anthony_salerno17).
A letter came with Dorian "Lucky" Metal: "I am Karel "Crow" Metal's older brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
Dorian "Lucky" Metal did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Dorian "Lucky" Metal fired back. Jonas Frederikgejl was badly wounded.
natakhtasha: Clement "Tin" Natakhtasha arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying a dented harmonica and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

Clement "Tin" Natakhtasha counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Tobias Niel was grazed. The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Clement "Tin" Natakhtasha looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Clement "Tin" Natakhtasha had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Gustav "Ghost" Xiii was grazed. The clerk counted the names twice. Clement "Tin" Natakhtasha is number 805 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In R-R9, Clement "Tin" Natakhtasha listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
A round went through the rim of Clement "Tin" Natakhtasha's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Tobias Niel of the Hegemony (@dfault_niel).

A bullet went into Clement "Tin" Natakhtasha's chest just under the heart at R-R9. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Tobias Niel of the Hegemony (@dfault_niel). Clement "Tin" Natakhtasha was killed at R-R9 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Tobias Niel of the Hegemony (@dfault_niel).
Dietrich "Bones" Natakhtasha came to the front because his cousin Clement "Tin" Natakhtasha never came home. He carries a dented harmonica.

Dietrich "Bones" Natakhtasha had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Ulrich "Bones" Swan crossed it, Dietrich "Bones" Natakhtasha fired. Ulrich "Bones" Swan was grazed. Dietrich "Bones" Natakhtasha was hit badly at Hill 304. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a bed. Dietrich "Bones" Natakhtasha held on as long as he could on the stretcher outside the aid post. There were not enough hands, and not enough beds.
The papers connected Otto Natakhtasha to Dietrich "Bones" Natakhtasha. The men took longer to learn Otto Natakhtasha's own habits, but they made the effort.
Otto Natakhtasha (Concord) shouted a challenge across to Otto Fin (Hegemony) at the Sunken Road. The answer was lost under the guns. Nobody repeated the challenge.
Otto Natakhtasha started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here."
Otto Natakhtasha taught a recruit to recognize letters by sound. By supper, the whole table was tapping out Morse on the planks.
nathan1780: Day 9: Oskar Nathan reached R-R16 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Oskar Nathan folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Oskar Nathan asked to see the second one. The barber laughed. Grey Mill has been won. Oskar Nathan listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Oskar Nathan worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost.
Karel Mstk (Concord) and Oskar Nathan (Hegemony) watched each other through the same loophole at Grey Mill for an hour. Neither fired. Neither will explain why.

Oskar Nathan had just lit a cigarette at R-R16 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Emil "Smokes" Pineapplejam of the Concord (@pineapplejamming).
Oskar Nathan's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. Mail came up the line with a letter for Oskar Nathan. Oskar Nathan read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Oskar Nathan traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch.

Oskar Nathan fired at a movement across the wire at R-R16. The man went down: Edmund Arvidgrubb, gravely wounded. A clear shot from R-R16. Oskar Nathan badly wounded Casimir Nile and slid back down below the parapet.
nikolozitchkoidze: The old hands of U-F6 have been here since Day 1. Gustav "Ash" Nikolozitchk has been here since Day 11. In a trench, that difference already feels like years. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Gustav "Ash" Nikolozitchk during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

A parcel came for Gustav "Ash" Nikolozitchk that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: several carefully wrapped biscuits. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping.
Gustav "Ash" Nikolozitchk sorted the dressings by lamplight. When the next stretcher arrived, he could find everything without looking.
Gustav "Ash" Nikolozitchk went out with a patrol to the Sunken Road and did not come back with it. He is listed as missing. The men leave his rations untouched.
Gustav "Ash" Nikolozitchk returned after being cut off near Verdel Ridge. He knew the password, but could barely make the sentry hear it.

At U-F6 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Gustav "Ash" Nikolozitchk turned around and took a shovel blow. Ulrich Pospisilikto of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Ulrich Pospisilikto of the Concord (@pospisiliktonda).
Gustav "Ash" Nikolozitchk's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at U-F6 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
ordinary_human51: Florian Human took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

Florian Human did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Florian Human fired back. Severin "Mud" Notbrayden was grazed. A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Florian Human across the shin at N-F6. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Viktor Fluffybaldy of the Concord (@fluffybaldy).
Florian Human's bandage soaked through twice in one night. The medic called the bearers before morning.
The stretcher Florian Human lay on for so long has a dent the shape of a body. Florian Human is back at N-F6, and someone else is lying in that dent now.
pavlos_1410: The draft reached U-F20 on Day 11. Ulrich "Lucky" Pavlos was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Ulrich "Lucky" Pavlos helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
A recruit asked Ulrich "Lucky" Pavlos how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label.
A football came over the parapet from the Hegemony side with Ulrich "Lucky" Pavlos's name scratched on it. Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr kicked it back. It did not come again.
Ulrich "Lucky" Pavlos and the recruit have reached whole words. Lessons take place beside the stove, with spelling corrections from people pretending not to listen.
A bullet clipped Ulrich "Lucky" Pavlos's helmet at U-F20 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Emil Train of the Concord (@goober_train).

Ulrich "Lucky" Pavlos was hit in the foot through his boot at U-F20. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Isidor "Saint" Michael of the Concord (@john.michael2877). Ulrich "Lucky" Pavlos died on a stretcher outside the aid post, still waiting for a bed. The medics had nothing left to give him.
A letter came with Dorian "Spark" Pavlos: "I am Ulrich "Lucky" Pavlos's father. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
Ulrich Pospisilikto (Concord) and Dorian "Spark" Pavlos (Hegemony) spotted the same abandoned cart near Saint-Ash crossroads. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was.
sabrina2000z: The new field cook gave his name as Otto Sabrina. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet hit Otto Sabrina in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at N-F15. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers.
Otto Sabrina held on as long as he could on the stretcher outside the aid post. There were not enough hands, and not enough beds.
The House of Sabrina sent Arno Sabrina after Otto Sabrina. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
Arno Sabrina gave Leopold Zushinku the last match in the trench. Leopold used it to light a candle so that Arno could finish a letter.
The listening post reported scraping beyond the wire. Arno Sabrina waited through an hour of it before a loose stake was found.
straitonjosh: By the time Tobias "Crow" Straitonjosh reached P-F21, the war was 10 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

Tobias "Crow" Straitonjosh polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Tobias "Crow" Straitonjosh watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Tobias "Crow" Straitonjosh was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony.
Tobias "Crow" Straitonjosh of the Concord and Ivo Razziel of the Hegemony have been shooting at the same tin can on the wire at the Bone Quarry for a week. Both trenches keep score.
Tobias "Crow" Straitonjosh cut Henrik Darryl's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.
Tobias "Crow" Straitonjosh had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Emil Ledude was grazed.
Tobias "Crow" Straitonjosh fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Hugo Plhubs was badly wounded.
Tobias "Crow" Straitonjosh's hands still remember being a clockmaker's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world.
theorethicall: Anselm "Shadow" Theorethical took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
A bucket appeared above the Hegemony parapet at the Ossuary Wood. Valentin Bjl fired. Anselm "Shadow" Theorethical pulled the bucket down. Later a sign went up: 'Water costs enough already.'
thorholting: Nobody saw Valentin Thorholting arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in S-S7, and a quiet rifleman under it.
Florian "Doc" Raumeidechse saw Valentin Thorholting freeze up on the fire step at the Ossuary Wood. Doc said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.
Valentin Thorholting had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any.
The men have learned that Valentin Thorholting draws portraits of the men in the margins of letters. Tonight it made them laugh, which was worth a great deal.
Valentin Thorholting found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Valentin Thorholting stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

A round went through the rim of Valentin Thorholting's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Walter Ice of the Hegemony (@iron__from__ice_). The clerk counted the names twice. Valentin Thorholting is number 433 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Valentin Thorholting looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
The wound on Valentin Thorholting's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.

Valentin Thorholting was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-S7. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Wendel Gers of the Hegemony (@j0seph_r0gers).
Valentin Thorholting's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
Valentin Thorholting made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Valentin Thorholting waited for that to change. When it did, Ulrich Tom was badly wounded.
Dawn watch. Valentin Thorholting put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Valentin Aklouisza, badly wounded.
